translations.translatedText: # Sunday 10.12.2017 (radio)
This year's Nobel Prizes have been awarded. Security at the Jewish synagogue in Helsinki is being increased. Men earn much more than women in top-level sport.
## The Nobel Prizes were awarded
![The Nobel banquet in Stockholm City Hall in December 2015.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9339516)
Open image viewer
The Nobel celebration always ends with a banquet in Stockholm. Photo: Jonas Ekströmer / EPA
This year's Nobel Prizes were awarded on Sunday.
The Nobel Peace Prize was awarded in Norway's capital, Oslo. The prize was given to the ICAN campaign. It is a campaign against nuclear weapons.
The other Nobel Prizes were awarded in Sweden's capital, Stockholm. King Carl Gustaf gave the Nobel Prizes to the winners in literature and the different fields of science.
After the prizes are awarded, a big banquet is always held in Stockholm. The Nobel winners and the Swedish royal family also take part in the celebration.
## The synagogue in Helsinki is being protected
![The Jewish community of Helsinki](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-7872984)
Open image viewer
The Jewish synagogue in Helsinki. Photo: Jussi Mansikka/Yle
Security is being increased at the Jewish synagogue in Helsinki. The Jewish community is also cooperating with the police.
Finnish Jews are worried about security because there was an attack against Jews in Sweden on Saturday. The attack happened in the city of Gothenburg. But nobody was injured.

The attackers in Gothenburg tried to set the synagogue on fire. They threw petrol bombs towards the synagogue, but the fire did not catch the building. During the attack, a party for Jewish young people was being held in the synagogue.

The security of Jews has become worse because of world politics. This week President Donald Trump decided that the USA recognises Jerusalem as the capital of Israel. Arab countries are angry about Trump's decision.
## Equality is missing from sport
![An infographic showing a woman's euro in top-level sport](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9967632)
Open image viewer
Photo: Lasse Isokangas, Yle News Graphics
In working life, equality is measured by whether women get the same pay as men for the same work. Finland is a fairly equal country, but one field is an exception. It is top-level sport.
Yle studied the income of female athletes from 2016. The result is that men earn much more than women in top-level sport.
A Finnish female athlete's euro is 3 cents. This means that a female athlete gets only 3 cents when a male athlete gets a euro.
The differences are greatest in team sports. For example, in ice hockey and football men get much more money than women. In ice hockey a woman's euro is only 0.3 cents.

Female athletes get closer to the income of male athletes in sports where people compete alone. For example, in skiing a woman's euro is 64 cents. In snowboarding, women's and men's incomes are already fairly close to each other.
